description: This Java class implements an event handling strategy for processing PolicyEntriesModified events within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence module. It extends a generic abstract event strategy and overrides the method to apply modifications to a policy based on the event data.

classes.name: PolicyEntriesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles PolicyEntriesModified events by updating a Policy object using a PolicyBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to apply changes from a PolicyEntriesModified event to a PolicyBuilder by removing current entries and setting new ones from the event.
